Landlords · 1 to 10 homes · in French

Landlord rent manager

For landlords who let one to ten homes themselves under French residential leases: every monthly instalment tracked (full or partial payments, days late, year grid), rent receipts (quittances) ready to print, reminder letters by level, the annual rent review computed with the IRL index you enter (deadline and letter included), yearly service charge reconciliation, deposit checks and gross and net yield per property. Not legal or tax advice.
